executive.label: Bottom line
executive.bottom_line: The firm-wide GIPS claim is correctly worded and verified through 2024 [S1] [S2]. Two Medium findings need answers before approval: composite assets in the DDQ do not match the GIPS Report, and the fee schedule omits the performance fee [S1] [S3].

blocks.text:
> SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE for layout testing. Basis: GIPS Composite Report (Global Value Equity, data through 2025-12-31), verification letter dated 2026-03-15 and DDQ section 7. Diligence review against the 2020 GIPS standards; not a verification or legal opinion.



- **Overall assessment:** Satisfactory with follow-ups.
- Firm-wide compliance claim uses the required wording (4.C.1) and is verified through 2024-12-31.
- **Medium:** the DDQ states composite assets of $2.4B; the GIPS Report shows $2.1B at 2025-12-31 (1.A.7).
- **Medium:** the fee schedule disclosure omits the performance fee (4.C.11).

blocks.title: Asset evidence needs reconciliation
blocks.text: **Observation:** The DDQ and GIPS Report differ on composite assets [S1, S3]. **Why it matters:** the inconsistency limits reliance on the reported composite scale. **Uncertainty:** the effective date of any asset change is not documented. **What would change the view:** evidence closing follow-up request 1.

### Performance Integrity & GIPS

**Overall assessment:** Satisfactory with follow-ups

**GIPS status:** Northfield claims compliance with the GIPS standards. Verified by Example Verifier LLP for 2015-01-01 to 2024-12-31. No performance examination of the composite. Report reviewed: Global Value Equity Composite, data through 2025-12-31.

**Key findings**
- [Medium] DDQ composite assets differ from the GIPS Report by $0.3B (1.A.7)
- [Medium] Fee schedule omits the performance fee (4.C.11)
- [Low] Verification gap of 12 months to the latest year-end

**Track record notes:** 11 years of annual returns, net of actual fees; global value equity benchmark; 14 portfolios; no carve-outs or portability.

**Follow-ups before approval**
1. Reconcile composite assets between the DDQ and the GIPS Report.
2. Provide the full fee schedule including the performance fee.
